data.title: Minimalism
data.tagline: Remove what does not help the task and make the remaining hierarchy clear
data.description: Modern minimalism uses restrained color, type, spacing, and decoration so the content and actions are easy to find. It is not simply an empty white page. Every remaining element needs a clear role, and the layout still needs contrast, rhythm, and feedback.

use: Portfolio and product pages with strong content
Products that need a calm, neutral base
avoid: Remove labels or guidance just to reduce visual density
Use low contrast and call it restraint
Leave large empty areas with no compositional purpose
Make every section look equally quiet

data.agentPrompt: Minimal SaaS landing page, generous whitespace, black, white, and gray with one accent color, hairline dividers, subtle shadows, 8px corner radius, 8-point spacing grid, large headlines with tight tracking
